set system name PE4.explanation: The name of the configuration device.

parameters.name: name
parameters.explanation: Name of the device, used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system services dhcpv4 server pool 1.template: set system services dhcpv4 server pool [parameter1]
set system services dhcpv4 server pool 1.command: set system services dhcpv4 server pool 10.1.5.0/24
set system services dhcpv4 server pool 1.explanation: This command configures a DHCPv4 server pool on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the name of the DHCP pool to be created or modified.

address-range low 10.1.5.1.explanation: Configures a DHCPv4 server pool with a specified address range starting from the low address defined by `[parameter2]`.

high 10.1.5.254.explanation: Configure the address pool and address range of the DHCPv4 server.

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: Autonomy system number for equipment, used for route agreements such as BGP.

remote-as 100.explanation: A remote autonomy system number with BGP equivalents.

set protocols bgp group AS100.explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

local-address Loopback1.explanation: Configure the local address of the BGP group.

parameters.name: local-address
parameters.explanation: Local address of the BGP group.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family mpls.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol community on the interface.

family inet xconnect-vfi vsi1.explanation: Configure the IPv4 protocol family of the interface and connect to the specified VFI.

parameters.name: vfi
parameters.explanation: The name of the virtual forwarding example.

set vlan unit 2.explanation: This command configures a VLAN interface unit (`unit [parameter1]`) on a Junos device, enabling Layer 3 functionality for the specified VLAN.

family inet address 10.1.5.2/30.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses and subnet masks for VLAN units.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to VLAN unit.

set forwarding-options label-switched-pa.command: set forwarding-options label-switched-path default rsvp-group no-te
set forwarding-options label-switched-pa.explanation: Configure the default label exchange path without the flow project.

set forwarding-options l2 forwarding vfi.command: set forwarding-options l2 forwarding vfi vsi1
set forwarding-options l2 forwarding vfi.explanation: Configure virtual forwarding examples of L2 forwards.

parameters.name: vfi
parameters.explanation: The name of the virtual forwarding example.

interface ge-0/0/3.1.explanation: Configure the interface for the virtual forwarding example of L2 forwarding.

set routing-table vrf vsi1.explanation: This command fragment configures a Virtual Routing and Forwarding (VRF) instance named `[parameter1]` within the routing table, isolating its routes from other VRFs.

route 4.4.4.4/32.explanation: This command adds a static route in the specified VRF (parameter1) for the destination network (parameter2) in the Junos routing table.

parameters.name: route
parameters.explanation: The IP address of the route and the mask.

next-hop self.explanation: Configures the path of the VRF route list.
